create_datasheet.description: Create a datasheet in a space, at the top or in a folder, with text fields of the names you give. The first is the primary field. With none, AITable adds three default fields.
create_datasheet.name: create_datasheet

parameters.description: The space. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: space_id

parameters.description: The datasheet's name, at most 100 characters.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: What the datasheet is for, at most 500 characters.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: Where to put it. Leave empty for the top of the space.
parameters.name: folder_id

parameters.description: The names of the text fields to start with, one per row. Other field types can be added afterwards.
parameters.name: field_names

datasheet_id.description: The new datasheet's id, to use as datasheet_id in other steps

create_field.description: Add a field (column) to a datasheet: text, number, currency, percent, date, checkbox, rating, select, website, phone, email or attachment. Only managers of the datasheet can add fields.
create_field.name: create_field

parameters.description: The space. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: space_id

parameters.description: The datasheet in that space. Pick one or give its id.
parameters.name: datasheet_id

parameters.description: The new field's name, at most 100 characters.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: What the field holds. It cannot be changed from a step later.
parameters.name: field_type

parameters.description: The choices people can pick from, one per row.
parameters.name: options

parameters.description: How many decimals to show, 0 to 4. Currency defaults to 2.
parameters.name: precision

parameters.description: Shown beside the value, such as $ or kg. Currency defaults to $.
parameters.name: symbol

parameters.description: The top of the scale, 1 to 10. The default is 5.
parameters.name: rating_max

parameters.description: Store a time of day as well as the date.
parameters.name: include_time

field_id.description: The new field's id, to use as field_id in other steps

create_record.description: Add a record to a datasheet. Fields left empty stay blank; text is turned into numbers, checkboxes, choices and dates for the field's type.
create_record.name: create_record

parameters.description: The datasheet. Pick one, give its id from an earlier step, or paste its address from the browser.
parameters.name: datasheet_id

parameters.description: The value for each field. Leave a field empty to leave it out; calculated fields are not offered.
parameters.name: fields

fields.description: The record's values by field name

record_id.description: The record's id, to use as record_id in other steps

create_records.description: Add up to 10 records in one step. Give a list with one object of field names and values per record.
create_records.name: create_records

parameters.description: The datasheet. Pick one, give its id from an earlier step, or paste its address from the browser.
parameters.name: datasheet_id

parameters.description: A list of up to 10 objects, each a record's values by field name, such as [{"Name": "Ada"}, {"Name": "Grace"}].
parameters.name: records

fields.description: The record's values by field name

delete_field.description: Delete a field and every value stored in it. Only managers of the datasheet can delete fields, and the primary field cannot be deleted.
delete_field.name: delete_field

parameters.description: The space. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: space_id

parameters.description: The datasheet in that space. Pick one or give its id.
parameters.name: datasheet_id

parameters.description: The field to delete. Pick one, or give its id from 'Create field'.
parameters.name: field_id

delete_record.description: Delete a record from a datasheet. Editors and managers can delete records.
delete_record.name: delete_record

parameters.description: The datasheet. Pick one, give its id from an earlier step, or paste its address from the browser.
parameters.name: datasheet_id

parameters.description: The record's id, from 'List records', 'Search records' or a create step.
parameters.name: record_id

delete_records.description: Delete up to 10 records in one step, given their ids.
delete_records.name: delete_records

parameters.description: The datasheet. Pick one, give its id from an earlier step, or paste its address from the browser.
parameters.name: datasheet_id

parameters.description: Up to 10 record ids, one per row, from a list or search step.
parameters.name: record_ids

get_node.description: Get one datasheet, folder, form or dashboard; for a folder, also the files directly inside it.
get_node.name: get_node

parameters.description: The space. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: space_id

parameters.description: The file or folder. Pick one at the top of the space, or give its id.
parameters.name: node_id

children.description: The files inside, for a folder

icon.description: Its icon, if it has one

is_favorite.description: True when it is pinned in the sidebar

parent_id.description: The folder it is in, empty at the top

permission.description: Your permission: 0 manager, 1 editor, 2 update-only, 3 read-only

icon.description: Its icon, if it has one

is_favorite.description: True when it is pinned in the sidebar

parent_id.description: The folder it is in, empty at the top

permission.description: Your permission: 0 manager, 1 editor, 2 update-only, 3 read-only

get_record.description: Get one record with all of its values.
get_record.name: get_record

parameters.description: The datasheet. Pick one, give its id from an earlier step, or paste its address from the browser.
parameters.name: datasheet_id

parameters.description: The record's id, from 'List records', 'Search records' or a create step.
parameters.name: record_id

fields.description: The record's values by field name

record_id.description: The record's id, to use as record_id in other steps

list_fields.description: List a datasheet's fields with their types, settings and which is the primary one; optionally as one view shows them.
list_fields.name: list_fields

parameters.description: The datasheet. Pick one, give its id from an earlier step, or paste its address from the browser.
parameters.name: datasheet_id

parameters.description: Only the fields this view shows, in its order.
parameters.name: view_id

editable.description: False when the field cannot be edited

is_primary.description: True for the datasheet's primary field

property.description: The field's settings, which depend on its type

list_nodes.description: List the datasheets, folders, forms and dashboards at the top of a space. To look inside a folder, use 'Get file'.
list_nodes.name: list_nodes

parameters.description: The space. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: space_id

icon.description: Its icon, if it has one

is_favorite.description: True when it is pinned in the sidebar

parent_id.description: The folder it is in, empty at the top

permission.description: Your permission: 0 manager, 1 editor, 2 update-only, 3 read-only

list_records.description: List a datasheet's records, a page at a time, optionally from one view, filtered by a formula or sorted by a field. Gets one page; for more, run it again with the next page number.
list_records.name: list_records

parameters.description: The datasheet. Pick one, give its id from an earlier step, or paste its address from the browser.
parameters.name: datasheet_id

parameters.description: Only the records and fields this view shows, in its order.
parameters.name: view_id

parameters.description: Only records where this AITable formula is true, such as {Status}="Done". To match text without a formula, use 'Search records'.
parameters.name: filter_formula

parameters.description: The field to sort by. Leave empty for the view's own order.
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.description: Which way to sort. Needs a field to sort by.
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.description: Values as stored (numbers, lists, dates as timestamps), or every value as the text AITable shows.
parameters.name: cell_format

parameters.description: How many records per page, 1 to 1000. The default is 100.
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description: Which page to get, starting at 1. The default is 1.
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.description: The most records to return in total, whatever the page size.
parameters.name: max_records

count.description: How many are on this page

has_more.description: True when a later page has more records

fields.description: The record's values by field name

total.description: How many records match in all

list_spaces.description: List the spaces you own or were invited to, with your admin status in each.
list_spaces.name: list_spaces

is_admin.description: True when you are an admin of the space

list_views.description: List a datasheet's views (grid, gallery, kanban and so on).
list_views.name: list_views

parameters.description: The datasheet. Pick one, give its id from an earlier step, or paste its address from the browser.
parameters.name: datasheet_id

search_nodes.description: Find datasheets, folders, forms, dashboards or mirrors anywhere in a space by part of their name, whatever folder they are in.
search_nodes.name: search_nodes

parameters.description: The space. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: space_id

parameters.description: Which kind of file to find.
parameters.name: node_type

parameters.description: Part of the name. Leave empty for every file of that kind.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Limit to files you can edit. Defaults to any access.
parameters.name: access

options.label: I can manage or edit it

icon.description: Its icon, if it has one

is_favorite.description: True when it is pinned in the sidebar

parent_id.description: The folder it is in, empty at the top

permission.description: Your permission: 0 manager, 1 editor, 2 update-only, 3 read-only

search_records.description: Find records whose chosen field contains, equals or starts with some text, ignoring case. Reads up to 5,000 rows and says when it stopped early.
search_records.name: search_records

parameters.description: The datasheet. Pick one, give its id from an earlier step, or paste its address from the browser.
parameters.name: datasheet_id

parameters.description: The field whose value is compared. Pick one or type its name.
parameters.name: search_field

parameters.description: How the field must match the text. Case is ignored.
parameters.name: match

parameters.description: The text to look for in that field.
parameters.name: value

parameters.description: The most matches to return, 1 to 1000. The default is 100.
parameters.name: max_results

records.description: The matching records, with values as text

fields.description: The record's values by field name

truncated.description: True when more rows may match than are shown

update_record.description: Change some fields of a record. Fields left empty keep their values; a value can't be cleared from here.
update_record.name: update_record

parameters.description: The datasheet. Pick one, give its id from an earlier step, or paste its address from the browser.
parameters.name: datasheet_id

parameters.description: The record's id, from 'List records', 'Search records' or a create step.
parameters.name: record_id

parameters.description: The value for each field. Leave a field empty to leave it out; calculated fields are not offered.
parameters.name: fields

fields.description: The record's values by field name

record_id.description: The record's id, to use as record_id in other steps

update_records.description: Change up to 10 records in one step. Give a list with one object per record: its record_id and the fields to change.
update_records.name: update_records

parameters.description: The datasheet. Pick one, give its id from an earlier step, or paste its address from the browser.
parameters.name: datasheet_id

parameters.description: A list of up to 10 objects, each with a record_id and the values to change, such as [{"record_id": "rec123", "Status": "Done"}].
parameters.name: records

fields.description: The record's values by field name

upload_attachment.description: Upload a file to a datasheet. It is not on any record until you give this step's 'attachments' to an attachment field in 'Create record' or 'Update record'. One file per step; a space holds 1 GB in all.
upload_attachment.name: upload_attachment

parameters.description: The datasheet. Pick one, give its id from an earlier step, or paste its address from the browser.
parameters.name: datasheet_id

parameters.description: Upload a file, pick one from an earlier step, or paste a link to one.
parameters.name: file

parameters.description: What to call the file in AITable, such as invoice.pdf. Leave blank to keep its own name.
parameters.name: file_name

attachment.description: The uploaded file as AITable describes it

height.description: Its height in pixels, for an image

preview.description: A preview address, for a PDF

token.description: The file's token, to give to an attachment field

url.description: Where the file can be opened

width.description: Its width in pixels, for an image

attachments.description: A list holding the file, to give to an attachment field

height.description: Its height in pixels, for an image

preview.description: A preview address, for a PDF

token.description: The file's token, to give to an attachment field

url.description: Where the file can be opened

width.description: Its width in pixels, for an image

description: Work with your AITable spaces: find datasheets, create datasheets and fields, list, search, create, update and delete records, and upload files for attachment fields.
